video_title: Hornets Hit Huge Cultural Reset + Huge Factors To Watch For Jaylen Brown, LeBron & Kawhi

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Miles Bridges traded to the Phoenix Suns
quotes.excerpt: Hornets' reset continues with Miles Bridges trade to Suns
quotes.quote: I expect there to be a rev up of NBA transactions tonight into tomorrow. Monday is the last day of the league year. A whole bunch of options and things are due. We have some bigger topics to go over, but there was just a trade in the NBA. Even though it involved a team in North Carolina and a team in Arizona, this is very much of a Michigan trade. Miles Bridges is being traded from the Charlotte Hornets to the Phoenix Suns for Grayson Allen, who has some North Carolina ties if I remember correctly, and Royce O'Neale. Poor Royce keeps getting traded. Everybody wants him.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Miles Bridges expected to sign contract extension with Suns
quotes.excerpt: My expectation is that Bridges will get a contract extension as part of this deal
quotes.quote: The Suns don't even technically have the first-round pick yet. They don't have the first-round pick until July 6th, but they've already traded it. They don't like to hold on to their first-round picks too long. My expectation is that Miles Bridges will get a contract extension as part of this deal and become the Suns' starting four-man going forward.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Charlotte Hornets undergo a cultural reset
quotes.excerpt: Charlotte, who just had their most successful season in a decade, does not feel good enough
quotes.quote: In the course of a few days, the Charlotte Hornets, who just had their most successful season in a decade, made it into the play-in tournament, all those positive vibes from winning in the play-in, kind of backed up by trading LaMelo Ball and Miles Bridges. Charlotte does not feel like they're good enough to compete. They have lots of cap flexibility. They can make more moves, but at the moment, it looks like they're taking a bit of a retro-fit step backwards.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Hornets building around Brandon Miller and Kon Knueppel
quotes.excerpt: They are taking a long-term view to build around a couple of top-five picks
quotes.quote: This is a cultural reset for the Charlotte Hornets. They are building around Brandon Miller, who's going to be 24 this next season, and Kon Knueppel, who's 21. They are taking a long-term view to build around a couple of top-five picks who have already been very productive. They didn't believe in LaMelo Ball as a cornerstone. They pounced on his value as soon as he had some. If they could have traded him last summer, they would have. They did it as soon as they could. And then with Miles Bridges, a talented guy, he's had some major, major off-court issues. As soon as they could get off him, they did.

quotes.speaker: Vince Goodwill
quotes.excerpt: It takes a sober executive, someone who's got some real life sobriety, to say this ain't it
quotes.quote: I give Jeff Peterson and the Charlotte Hornets a lot of credit. It takes a sober executive, someone who's got some real life sobriety, to say this ain't it. This isn't sustainable. Maybe it is sustainable, but the return I'm going to get on this, how high I'm going to go with these guys as our cornerstones in this Eastern Conference, ain't high enough for me to just go all in on these guys. We don't even mention the nonsense that Miles Bridges was involved in a couple of years. Having to sit out the entire year because of the nonsense that he was involved in, and now you can ship him off to Michigan State Southwest and tell him, hey, maybe he's reformed, maybe he's not. Not our problem anymore. That's a huge, huge thing.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Boston Celtics seeking draft capital for Jaylen Brown
quotes.excerpt: Boston, in some talks with some teams, has been seeking heavy draft capital from teams
quotes.quote: The Jaylen Brown situation is very heavily on the minds of a lot of teams. There's a lot of discussion. Boston is actively making calls. I have been told that, maybe not everything, everyone that they're trying, but Boston, in some talks with some teams, has been seeking heavy draft capital from teams as they discuss Jaylen Brown trades. I heard of one team where they asked for five future first-round picks.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Difficulty of trading a perennial All-NBA player
quotes.excerpt: It is extremely difficult to trade a perennial All-NBA player in his prime and immediately get better
quotes.quote: It is extremely difficult to trade a perennial All-NBA player in his prime and immediately get better. That's the challenge for Brad Stevens. And look, if you trade him for Giannis, then yeah, you just did it. But by dangling Jaylen Brown in that deal for Giannis, they essentially got themselves out over the cliff and now they just got to figure out how to land. They got to stick a landing because I don't think there's any, 'Oh hey Jaylen, no, no, no, listen, let me just rub your back a little bit and tell you how much we love you.' I think they're beyond that point.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Andrew Wiggins expected to pick up player option
quotes.excerpt: I think Andrew Wiggins is going to pick up his option. I don't think they're going to do a new deal
quotes.quote: I think Andrew Wiggins is going to pick up his option. I don't think they're going to do a new deal. We talked about that. Could change, but I think Wiggins by Monday, maybe even by the time this podcast comes out, Andrew Wiggins, from what I understand, is going to pick up his option, $30 million. That's going to leave the Heat with $18 million to spend on five players.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Raptors in trade talks with Clippers for Kawhi Leonard
quotes.excerpt: There is significant discussion out there in the league that they are in conversations with the Clippers
quotes.quote: There is significant discussion out there in the league that they are in conversations with the Clippers about Kawhi Leonard. Now, this is obviously a fascinating storyline because he left Toronto. Do you think that offer still stands? That's my question.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Clippers under investigation for potential illegal activities
quotes.excerpt: I have questioned whether the league would allow his contract to be extended if it's being investigated
quotes.quote: There's also the aspirations scandal which we don't know what's going on. And I have questioned whether the league would allow his contract to be extended if it's being investigated for being illegal in some terms. And I have questioned whether the league would allow him to be traded if there's some spectre of him being suspended. The league has to protect its other teams. But considering these trade talks are going on at some level, it indicates to me that the Clippers think that they could trade him theoretically.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James expected to pick up player option
quotes.excerpt: I think it is very likely that they're going to pick up that option
quotes.quote: Tomorrow, LeBron James has a guarantee date in his contract. His contract is partially guaranteed. It is guaranteed for 1.2 million right now. And if if they pick up the option, it's 2.2 million. I think it is very likely that they're going to pick up that option because Bronny had an increased role going down the stretch of the season.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Lakers reached out to LeBron James regarding contract
quotes.excerpt: They reached out to LeBron's representative to Rich Paul and said, we'd like to have LeBron back
quotes.quote: They reached out to LeBron's representative to Rich Paul and said, we'd like to have LeBron back. But there have been no further talks. And from what I understand, like the Lakers have not made an offer, but LeBron, from what I understand as of today when I got this update, LeBron has not made himself available to meet with the Lakers yet.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James prioritizing happiness over money
quotes.excerpt: The number one thing for LeBron next season is happiness, not money
quotes.quote: It's been communicated to me that the number one thing for LeBron next season is happiness, not money. So this is obviously we knew that he's going to have to take a pay cut from 50 million. So that has been communicated to me. And what does that mean? I don't know. Does that mean he's willing to take the mid-level? Does that mean he's willing to take the taxpayer mid-level? The mid-level is about 15, the taxpayer mid-level is like six and a half or seven or something like that. The minimum is three, nine or four, something like that. I don't know what that means.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green expected to pick up player option
quotes.excerpt: It is likely that Draymond will pick that contract option up
quotes.quote: On Monday, Draymond Green has a $27 million player option in his contract. It is likely that Draymond will pick that contract option up. And listen, if he doesn't pick it up, it doesn't necessarily mean that LeBron would be going to the Warriors. However, if Draymond, who is represented by Rich Paul and is close to LeBron, if Draymond passes on that contract option, the possibility exists of him taking less money and him taking money in a spot that can give the Warriors a pathway to get the $15 million full mid-level.
